summary: Base-game-friendly story ingredients. Used when the player skips packs or picks packs that don't have notes yet.
characterTypes: A struggling artist who sells paintings to pay rent and resents anyone who calls it a hobby
A burnt-out career climber who just quit their job with no plan
A teen who wants out of their small town more than anything
A retired Sim who has outlived their friends and wants one last adventure
A charming flirt who has never had a relationship last a month
A perfectionist host who throws parties to hide how lonely they are
A stay-at-home parent who used to be a rising star in something
A slob roommate with a heart of gold and terrible timing

hooks.text: Someone inherits a house they didn't know existed
Two exes are forced to share a lot after a money disaster
A household starts with almost no money and one big dream
A new neighbor moves in and immediately knows too much about everyone
Best friends open a small business together
A big family reunion happens at the worst possible time
Someone moves to a new town to start over and keeps their past a secret
A single parent and their kid move in with a grandparent they barely know

twists.text: A secret sibling turns up at the door
Two rivals are forced to work the same career track
A love triangle forms between people who all live in the same house
Someone gets the promotion everyone else wanted
A quiet character is revealed to be secretly famous online
An unexpected friendship grows between two characters who started as enemies
A surprise pregnancy shakes up everyone's plans
The house itself needs a full rebuild after a fire

settings: A cramped starter home that clearly needs renovating
A big, run-down family house with too many bedrooms and too many memories
A shared apartment-style lot with thin walls
A quiet suburban street where everyone watches everyone
A park lot that becomes the household's go-to hangout
